protocol.title: Digital Microfluidic Magnetic Separation for Particle-Based Immunoassays
protocol.platform: Digital microfluidics (DMF), air-matrix (oil-free), paramagnetic microparticle-based immunoassay
protocol.objective: First particle-based immunoassay on DMF without oil carrier fluid; development of supernatant separation washing method; competitive immunoassay for E2 and noncompetitive immunoassay for TSH with 100-fold reagent reduction and 10-fold faster analysis vs. well-plate ELISA

device.electrode_array: Generic array-geometry; droplets manipulated without changing device design

magnet.positioning: Movable; placed in manifold below device; controlled manually via metal clip
magnet.manifold: Stripwell microplate with selected wells removed to form grooves for magnet positioning

detection.instrument: Pherastar plate reader (BMG Labtech, Cary, NC)
detection.format: Device affixed with tape to empty 96-well Stripwell plate; detection zone aligned per-well

fouling_mitigation.notes: Included in all reagent and sample solutions to enable robust droplet movement without oil; donated by Brenntag Canada (Toronto, ON)

tsh_particle_blocking.purpose: Reduce nonspecific adsorption of anti-TSH-HRP conjugate onto particle surfaces; eliminates high background noise preventing differentiation between 0 and 0.4 uIU/mL analyte

e2_assay.conjugate: E2-HRP (E2 antigen labeled with horseradish peroxidase)
e2_assay.sample_source: E2 calibration standards (0, 10, 50, 500, 1000 pg/mL) from Calbiotech ELISA kit

tsh_assay.sample_source: TSH calibration standards (0, 0.4, 1, 4, 20 uIU/mL) from Calbiotech ELISA kit

reagents.wash_buffer: Custom DMF-compatible wash buffer (L64 as sole surfactant)

substrate.notes: Sequential on-chip mixing: 2x H2O2 wash steps to remove residual wash buffer, then H2O2 substrate incubation 2 min, then merge with luminol/enhancer immediately prior to detection. Pre-mixing H2O2 and luminol before dispensing caused high inter-assay variability.

reagents.elisa_kits: Calbiotech (Spring Valley, CA) E2 and TSH well-plate ELISA kits (used for well-plate comparison and TMB wash-test)

serial_dilution.description: Particles immobilised by magnet; droplet diluted by merging with wash buffer droplet; DMF splits pooled droplet; excess solution removed; repeated until sufficient dilution achieved
serial_dilution.efficiency: Inherently inefficient: unbound reagents slowly diluted over many washes; magnet immobilises particles throughout, trapping unbound material between particles
serial_dilution.reference: Previously used in all DMF magnetic particle immunoassays (Sista et al. 2008; Vergauwe et al. 2011)

supernatant_separation.description: Magnet focuses particles into pellet and immobilises on device surface; supernatant droplet actuated away to waste; magnet removed; fresh droplet passed over pellet and shuttled in circular motion across 4 electrodes to resuspend particles
supernatant_separation.efficiency: Achieves >90% unbound reagent removal in one step
requirements: Sufficient magnetic force: pellet magnetic force (~470 uN) must exceed droplet interfacial force
Adjustable magnetic force: magnet moved horizontally away from device for particle resuspension
Stable particle suspension: ~5% residual liquid retained by hydrophilic particles during pellet phase; immediate resuspension prevents aggregation or drying
supernatant_separation.notes: Incompatible with oil-immersed DMF devices. Choice of method depends on instrument complexity: serial dilution suits static-magnet instruments; supernatant separation requires movable or electromagnet.

steps.name: Particle separation from diluent
steps.notes: 1 unit droplet of antibody-coated paramagnetic particle suspension dispensed from reservoir. Magnet positioned to immobilise particles as pellet. Diluent supernatant actuated away to waste. ~5% residual liquid retained by hydrophilic particle pellet.

steps.name: Sample incubation
steps.notes: Three 800 nL sample droplets (total 2.4 uL) sequentially dispensed and delivered to particle pellet for resuspension and incubation. 6 min sufficient to saturate analyte binding on particle surfaces. Evaporation: <5% volume loss in >=30 min for 1 uL droplet. E2 (competitive): unlabeled E2 in sample occupies anti-E2 binding sites. TSH (noncompetitive): TSH antigen captured by anti-beta-TSH antibody on particle surface.

steps.name: Post-sample wash x4
steps.notes: Four supernatant separation wash cycles remove unbound sample matrix, excess antigen, and non-specifically bound proteins. Each cycle: magnet immobilises pellet, supernatant actuated to waste, fresh wash buffer droplet reconstitutes particles with 4-electrode circular motion.

steps.name: Conjugate incubation
steps.notes: E2 (competitive): E2-HRP at 1 ug/mL competes with sample E2 for residual anti-E2 binding sites. Higher E2-HRP concentrations collapse dynamic range (50 and 500 pg/mL become indistinguishable). TSH (noncompetitive): Anti-TSH-HRP detection antibody binds TSH at a different epitope from capture antibody, forming antibody-antigen-antibody sandwich complex. Milk-blocked TSH particles reduce nonspecific adsorption of anti-TSH-HRP.

steps.name: Post-conjugate wash x4
steps.notes: Four supernatant separation wash cycles remove unbound HRP-labeled conjugate.

steps.name: H2O2 pre-rinse x2
steps.notes: Two H2O2 wash cycles remove residual wash buffer prior to substrate delivery. Prevents dilution or interference with H2O2/luminol chemiluminescent reaction. Replaces manufacturer-recommended pre-mix of H2O2 and luminol, which caused high inter-assay variability.

steps.name: H2O2 substrate incubation
steps.protocol: E2 and TSH (identical); particles delivered to shared detection region
steps.notes: Particles reconstituted in 1 unit H2O2 droplet in the detection region. H2O2 serves as oxidising co-substrate for HRP. Detection region rinsed with H2O2 between assays.

steps.name: Chemiluminescence activation and detection
steps.notes: 1 unit luminol/enhancer droplet merged on-chip with H2O2/particle droplet. HRP catalyses oxidation of luminol by H2O2, generating chemiluminescence. Signal saturates at 1 min (chosen as measurement endpoint). Detection by Pherastar plate reader (LUM module, gain=3600, focal height=8.6 mm). Device taped to empty 96-well Stripwell plate aligned per-well.

e2_competitive_immunoassay.clinical_application: Ovarian cancer screening (E2 > 20 pg/mL depending on patient age)

tsh_noncompetitive_immunoassay.clinical_application: Diagnosis of hypothyroidism (TSH > 3.0 uIU/mL); normal serum range 0.4-3.0 uIU/mL

time_reduction.mechanism: Reduced reagent volumes pack the same number of particles into smaller volume, increasing surface-area-to-volume ratio and accelerating reaction kinetics
